ExplanationAuthor.description:
Who wrote the text. It was written by an AI (Claude, called through the Claude Code CLI) from the model's
published files only (rules, importance, card metrics, summary, registry), and is not a human analysis.

model.description: The AI model as the tool reported it (e.g. 'claude-opus-5-5').
model.title: Model

tool.description: What produced the text, e.g. 'Claude Code' (the CLI that called the model).
tool.title: Tool

tool_version.description: Version of that tool, as it reports it (e.g. '2.1.319').
tool_version.title: Tool Version

ExplanationAuthor.title: ExplanationAuthor

ExplanationText.description: The explanation in one language: a headline, a few short paragraphs and a few points to check on the page.

points.description: Things the reader can check in the rules below.
points.title: Points

ExplanationText.title: ExplanationText

description:
v0.6.2: a short explanation of one published model's rule base, in Spanish and English, written by an AI from
a template (``configs/explanations/TEMPLATE.md``) and the model's published files. Every number in it is one of
the published figures; the text describes how the model maps inputs to outputs and claims no causes.

input_sha256.description: sha256 of the context JSON built from the published files; a republished model no longer matches.
input_sha256.title: Input Sha256

reviewed.description: True once a person has read the text against the rules and metrics.
reviewed.title: Reviewed

synthetic.description: True for fixtures; the UI must label them as synthetic.
synthetic.title: Synthetic

template_version.description: Version of the template the text was written from.
template_version.title: Template Version

title: ModelExplanation
